name: Write humorous or creative fictional stories
description: Users requested the creation of humorous, comedic, or creative short stories and scripts, often featuring specific fictional characters, absurd scenarios, or detailed sensories such as toileting, mess, or bodily functions. The prompts frequently included specific formatting constraints, such as word counts, point-of-view instructions, or requests for plot continuations.
